  • LMFS-OP-020
  • LMFS-OP-047

    • The purpose of this course is to identify the specific requirements of issuing ATC clearances or requests, including your responsibilities and the qualifications on when you can transfer a clearance request from your facility. It is imperative that clearances and requests are accomplished as required in accordance with the 7110.10 and Lockheed Martin procedures. With references and End-of-Course review questions, and in accordance with FAA Orders JO 7110.10, Flight Services and JO 7110.65, Air Traffic Control; LMFS-OP-020, Facility SOP; and LMFS-OP-047, Relaying ATC Clearances; you will identify:

  • The requirements of issuing ATC clearances or requests.
